headline: 5 Farm Equipment Stocks to Watch as Industry Shows Promise

headline: Zebra Technologies (ZBRA) Beats Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Zebra (ZBRA) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +45.98% and +3.90%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
